errors.code_expired: That code has expired. Start over to have a new one sent.
errors.email_invalid: That email address doesn't look right. Check it and try again.
errors.flood_wait: Telegram has asked us to slow down. Try again in about {wait}.
errors.no_account: This number has no Telegram account yet. Create one in the Telegram app, then sign in here.
errors.no_answer: Telegram didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.no_api_credentials: No Telegram API credentials in this build. Add TG_API_ID and TG_API_HASH to local.properties and rebuild.
errors.no_space: This device has run out of storage. Free up some space, then try again.
errors.offline: Can't reach Telegram. Check this device's internet connection.
errors.phone_invalid: That number isn't one Telegram recognises. Include the country code, as in +44.
errors.premium_sign_in: Telegram won't send this number a code here. Sign in with a QR code from the Telegram app instead: start over, then choose Scan a QR code.
errors.signed_out: Telegram signed this device out. Sign in again to carry on.
errors.tdlib_unavailable: TDLib, the part of TMPlayer Music that talks to Telegram, could not start on this device. Please report this with the message: {message}
errors.unsupported_sign_in_step: This account needs a step TMPlayer Music can't do. Finish signing in in the Telegram app first, then try again.

library.counts: {songs, plural, one {# song} other {# songs}} ({files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}})
library.empty: No songs yet. Add chats with music in Manage chats, or wait for the scan to find them.

login.choose_body: Play the audio files already in your own Telegram chats. Sign in to pick the chats with your music.
login.code_body_app: Telegram sent the code to the Telegram app on your other device.
login.phone_body: Include the country code, as in +44 7700 900123.
login.qr_body: On your phone, open Telegram, go to Settings, then Devices, then Link Desktop Device, and scan this code.
login.stalled: This is taking longer than usual. Check the connection, then try again.

manage.body: These chats are read for audio. Removing one takes its tracks out of the library; your messages in Telegram are not touched.
manage.remove_body: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing from this chat is in your library yet.} one {# track leaves your library.} other {# tracks leave your library.}} Your messages in Telegram are not touched.
manage.scanning: {count, plural, one {Scanning, # track so far} other {Scanning, # tracks so far}}
manage.title: Manage chats

picker.body: Tick the chats that hold your music. You can add or remove chats later in Manage chats.
picker.confirm_all_body: Scanning many chats takes longer and uses more data. You can remove chats later.
picker.count: {count, plural, one {# audio file} other {# audio files}}
picker.empty: No chats yet. Chats you join in Telegram show up here.
picker.no_audio: No audio messages. Files sent as documents are found by the scan.
picker.title: Pick the chats with music
picker.total: {chats, plural, one {# chat} other {# chats}}, {files, plural, =0 {counting files} one {about # file} other {about # files}}

player.unknown_length: The length of this track is not known, so it can't be seeked.

scan.running: Scanning {current} of {total} chats, {found, plural, one {# track so far} other {# tracks so far}}
scan.tags: Reading tags, {count, plural, one {# file done} other {# files done}}
scan.waiting: Telegram asked us to wait {seconds} s before reading more

versions.tap_to_play: Tap a version to play it.
versions.why_lossless: Plays the lossless version by default.
versions.why_oldest: These versions are alike, so the first one posted plays by default.
versions.why_on_device: Plays the version already on this device by default.
versions.why_playable: Plays the version this app can play by default.
versions.why_preferred: Plays the version you chose by default.
versions.why_quality: Plays the version with the higher quality by default.
versions.why_smaller: Plays the smaller version by default to save mobile data.
versions.why_tags: Plays the version with the fuller details by default.

welcome.body: A player for the audio files already in your own Telegram chats. You choose which chats it reads; nothing else is touched.
